label: Per-se intellectual operation and…: OperationAttribution supplies exercise attribution, bodily…
definition: OperationAttribution supplies exercise attribution, bodily participation, accidental/material-form inherence and completeness separately. PerSeIntellectualOperation is an attributed intellectual exercise without bodily participation. It is not merely the absence of an organ or a current thinking episode. BodyShares concerns exercise, not object-side phantasms. NonorganicOperationAttribution asserts the missing bridge explicitly. Ad 2 more properly attributes understanding to the human being through the soul.
